I am 53 years old with no schooling, living in the Somalie region where the rains are unpredictable and drought is always a threat. My family keeps livestock like many here, so I will spread manure from my animals on this 0.30-hectare maize plot, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer because it is too expensive and risky when the rains might fail. I plant local maize seed that survives dry spells, and I do not have access to irrigation, pesticides, or the money to hire workers. My family will do all the labor ourselves since the plot is small.
